name: MAATAA UI V3
certificationTarget: M0R + M1 compatibility freeze + M2 real-browser and React-adapter certification on the 11-package kernel

invariants.statement: UI-supplied authority claims cannot bypass policy and approval.
invariants.test: INV-001 UI authority flags cannot bypass policy

invariants.statement: Prompt text is not authorization.
invariants.test: INV-002 prompt text cannot satisfy authorization

invariants.statement: Acknowledgement is not verification.
invariants.test: INV-003 acknowledged command can still fail verification

invariants.statement: Renderer executes no payload code and rejects hostile data at runtime.
invariants.test: renderer rejects nested hostile payloads at runtime without invoking accessors

invariants.statement: Hardware safety readiness and active interlocks remain external preconditions to dispatch.
invariants.test: INV-005 hardware safety state can deny an otherwise approved command

invariants.statement: Foundation packages never depend on domain packs; experimental domain packs may depend only on approved foundation packages.
invariants.test: INV-006 experimental domain fixture obeys one-way package boundaries

invariants.statement: Frozen v1 contracts cannot change shape or identity without a new contract version.
invariants.test: INV-007 frozen v1 contract baseline remains compatible

invariants.statement: Frozen public package exports cannot be removed from the 0.3.x API surface.
invariants.test: INV-008 public API baseline exports remain available

invariants.statement: Frozen registry entries cannot silently change identity, authority class, package, headless status, schema binding, or supported states.
invariants.test: INV-009 registry baseline remains compatible

invariants.statement: Terminal control states cannot transition back to active states.
invariants.test: INV-010 terminal control states cannot transition back to active states

invariants.statement: NACK cannot transition to verified.
invariants.test: INV-011 NACK cannot transition to verified

invariants.statement: Cancelled commands cannot transition to completed.
invariants.test: INV-012 cancelled commands cannot transition to completed

invariants.statement: Expired leases cannot authorize dispatch.
invariants.test: INV-013 expired lease cannot authorize dispatch

invariants.statement: Verification is derived from observed state rather than acknowledgement payload.
invariants.test: INV-014 verification result is derived from observed state, not ACK payload

invariants.statement: The React adapter rejects hosts that do not satisfy its declared host contract.
invariants.test: INV-015 React adapter rejects incomplete host contracts

invariants.statement: React adapter primitives preserve native accessible semantics in a real browser.
invariants.test: INV-016 React adapter primitives expose accessible browser semantics

invariants.statement: Keyboard navigation and focus restoration remain deterministic.
invariants.test: INV-017 keyboard navigation and focus restoration pass

invariants.statement: Dynamic command feedback is exposed through a live region.
invariants.test: INV-018 command feedback is exposed through a live region

invariants.statement: Certified responsive viewports do not introduce horizontal overflow.
invariants.test: INV-019 responsive viewport matrix has no horizontal overflow

invariants.statement: Reduced-motion preference disables nonessential animation.
invariants.test: INV-020 reduced motion disables nonessential animation

invariants.statement: Forced-colors mode preserves visible control boundaries and focus.
invariants.test: INV-021 forced colors preserves control boundaries

invariants.statement: Certified visual fixtures remain within the screenshot regression threshold.
invariants.test: INV-022 screenshot visual regression remains within threshold

scope: foundation audit recorded without rewriting history
registry compatibility baseline with binding metadata
screenshot visual regression with explicit update enforcement
published invariant, gate, React-surface, certified-surface, and exclusions maps
M0R findings resolved or explicitly deferred

runtimeDependencyPolicy.claim: zero external runtime dependencies in package dependencies

browserCertification.runtime: system Chromium 144.0.7559.96 via Chrome DevTools Protocol

reactAdapterCertification.scope: MAATAA adapter host contract and resulting browser semantics

notCertified: third-party React implementation or React version matrix; M2 certifies the MAATAA host-adapter contract only
full WCAG conformance or manual assistive-technology certification
real robotics, PLC, IoT, building, industrial, show-control, mobility or energy control
hardware-in-the-loop operation or safety-rated emergency control
penetration testing, external security audit or production deployment
visual regression for the full public landing page or all 90 registry components
browser rendering for headless-bound registry entries other than the explicitly certified React primitives
M3 deferred React hooks until implemented and separately tested

deferredNonBlocking: full visual implementation of the 90 headless-bound registry components
broad domain examples beyond certified kernel/reference fixtures
